headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.24
summary: New storage location setting: move the launcher off the media-scanner-indexed Android/media folder onto Android/data or internal storage for calmer, faster I/O, with a guided migration for your existing game data.

items.text: New Storage location option in Settings: pick Android/data or internal storage instead of Android/media, which the system media scanner keeps indexing and can make large installs stutter.
Switching storage now asks before moving your existing data, warns when the new location already has data, and blocks switching while the game is running.
